head_commit.message:
fix: supply AUTH_SECRET to E2E compose interpolation for CI

The base compose hard-requires ${AUTH_SECRET:?}; on dev machines the
.env file masks this, but CI has no .env so compose up failed during
interpolation. The harness now owns all three required values
(POSTGRES_PASSWORD, CRON_SECRET, AUTH_SECRET) explicitly.

workflow_runs.display_title: fix: call siteSettingsGET() without args in cache-headers test (unblock CI + Vercel)

head_commit.message:
fix: call siteSettingsGET() without args in cache-headers test

TS2554 (Expected 0 arguments, but got 1) broke tsc --noEmit, CI,
hooks-gate, and Vercel production builds since fcbe512. The route
handler takes no request argument and the test only asserts the
Cache-Control response header, so no mock Request is needed. Note:
'as any' on the argument does not suppress arity checking.

Co-authored-by: arena-agent <297053741+arena-agent@users.noreply.github.com>
